verdict.rationale: A registered-agent and business-formation service could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, such as automatic compliance filings or mail-handling rules, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party content: the site returned a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt, and the only community item comments on the company's SEO. Nothing shows any automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
